prompt: A single in-game screenshot of a cozy, story-driven pixel art life-simulation game, 16:9, no user interface. ART STYLE: polished modern pixel art, large clean readable shapes, a clean dark outline around every building, prop and character, flat cel shading with only two or three tones per material, a limited rich warm palette (terracotta, cream, jade green, warm wood brown, faded red, soft sky blue in shadows is NOT allowed - shadows are warm), NO noise, NO random speckles, NO dithering, NO blur, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, perfectly straight horizontal and vertical lines, every art pixel is a crisp square of exactly 3 image pixels (the picture is a 512x288 game screen enlarged 3 times with nearest neighbour). SCENE: a sunny afternoon corner of an old Lingnan-style harbour town street in a fictional southern Chinese city. Along the back, attached old shophouses of DIFFERENT heights: on the left a three-storey cream plastered arcade shophouse (qilou) with square columns at the front, a wonton noodle shop under the arcade with a big steaming soup pot and wooden stools; next to it a LOW two-storey herbal tea shop with a dark green wooden shopfront and shiny brass tea urns on the counter, potted herbs on its roof terrace; on the right a small single-storey old Chinese temple with red pillars, a grey tiled roof with curled ridge ornaments, two stone lions and a stone-paved forecourt. Rooftops: water tanks, bamboo laundry poles with clothes, potted plants. Each shop has one large clean BLANK signboard panel, a single flat colour, absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO Chinese characters, NO numbers anywhere in the image. In front: a wide grey paved sidewalk with a kerb, ONE street tree in a square tree pit, one old street lamp, a bicycle leaning on a column, then a two-lane asphalt road with faded markings. Characters: a young adult traveller stands on the sidewalk, facing the camera: short black hair, mustard-yellow light trench coat, dark charcoal trousers, old sneakers, a travel backpack with a folded umbrella in its side pocket; cute but realistic proportions about three heads tall; the character is about one quarter of the height of the two-storey shop. An old man sits on a stool outside the noodle shop, a woman walks by with a shopping bag. Everything original, no logos.
